outcome: pelvic floor trauma assessed by elastography and B-mode ultrasonography
cohort: 86 postpartum primiparous women, 43 who underwent cesarean section and 43 who had a vaginal delivery.
finding: Elastography identified more trauma-suspicious lesions in the pelvic floor compared to B-mode ultrasonography, particularly in women who had a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Elastography revealed more trauma-suspicious lesions in the pelvic floor of women who had a vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section.
